candidates.reason: Represents the first seven calendar days with explicit day membership, retaining anomalous dates and preserving NULL filtering, aliases, types, and duplicate counts.
candidates.sql: SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) GROUP BY 1, 2
